column1: # Hearth & Harvest: every dish, kitchen ingredient and station recipe. python tools/hearth/hearth.py compiles this table.
# station     pot (on a lit campfire or fire), oven (burns fuel) or prep (the prep table, no heat)
# ingredients one per grid slot, separated by ";". Bare names are Village Friends items when one exists
#             (onion, flour, cheese...) and Minecraft items otherwise; "x*2" takes two slots; "#fish" is the
#             item tag villagefriends:cooking/fish; other tags are written "#namespace:path".
# vessel      bowl or bottle: the pot's container slot (oven and prep recipes take it as one more ingredient),
#             and what you keep after eating. "-" for none.
# makes       how many one batch makes. time: seconds to cook.
# food/sat    nutrition and saturation modifier. tier: Well Fed I-III (0 = a plain ingredient, no buff).
# buff        Well Fed seconds. serve: what residents' animations call it (stew pie bread platter tart cider).
# meals       where residents eat it: breakfast lunch supper (at home), tavern (the cook's dish of the day),
#             picnic, party (the birthday cake), winter (keeps well).
# likes       who tends to have it as their favourite: personalities, jobs, or child.
# flags       ingredient (a kitchen ingredient, not a dish), existing (an item Village Friends already had),
#             secret (a family recipe: hidden until you learn it from a recipe card), needs:<modid>.
